heard: One day Jacob was cooking stew Esau came in exhausted from the field Quick, let me go down that red stuff So he was called Edom in the heat Sell me a birthright, Jacob said Look, I am about to die, he replied. Swear it to me here and now. So he sold his birth right away. This is nothing less than the house of God. This is the gate of heaven open wide. Angels go up and down on the stairs
